pages.raw_meta: We connect patients and caregivers through safe, life-saving, life-enhancing medical devices, providing innovative and cost-effective patient care solutions.
raw_blocks: Pulling into the parking lot before most of the world is even awake. Or walking out under the stars at the end of a 12-hour shift. No matter who you are: Clinician, caregiver or administrator, you carry a heavy load. The weight of decisions. Of team members. Of patients and families. Of why you got into this in the first place.
And we build for you.

Every tool is designed to meet the real-world demands of every shift, every patient, every moment. They're made to simplify complexity. To streamline workflows. To help reduce risks before they happen. To support decisions under pressure.
From IV lines to vital signs, we're with you at the heart of care.
From catheters to pumps, you can standardize without clinical compromise, so every drop reaches patients safely and every shift runs smoother.
Compounding automation, closed system transfer devices, and IV safety software built to give you less pressure and more performance.
From tracheostomy tubes to breathing support, our tools are designed to make every breath count and help everyone breathe a little easier.
Monitoring technologies that bring clarity to critical decisions without slowing you down.
From fluid warming to temperature probes, we help you protect patients perioperatively, so they stay safe and stable in your care.
Help protect hemodialysis catheters, reduce infection risks, and build the trust that renal care depends on.
From spinal and epidural to regional blocks and diagnostic trays, we give you the right tools to ease pain and deliver comfort with confidence.
Introducing the IV Performance Platform

Lead a new wave of IV therapy performance with an intuitive platform designed to help bring safety, simplicity, and clarity to patient care. Comprised of Plum Duo ™ and Plum Solo ™ * precision IV pumps and LifeShield ™ IV safety software, this fully IV-EHR interoperable, future-ready platform empowers you to raise the performance of your IV therapy practice—helping to enhance safety and efficiency across all IV touchpoints.
*Plum Duo v1.2 and Plum Solo v1.0
Stay up to date with our latest news

News / Sep 18, 2025 ICU Medical Announces New FDA 510(k) cleared labeling claims for Clave ™ Portfolio of Needlefree IV Connectors with Powerful New Infection Control Data New labeling clearance highlights peer-reviewed evidence showing hospitals that standardize on Clave technology achieve significantly greater infection reduction and cost savings compared to non-Clave hospitals.

News / May 01, 2025 ICU Medical, Inc. and Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, Inc. Complete Joint Venture to Bolster IV Solutions Manufacturing and Innovation in North America The partnership creates one of the largest global IV solutions manufacturing networks with combined production of an estimated 1.4 billion annual units and aims to bring additional supply chain resiliency and new innovation to the North American IV solutions market.

News / Apr 07, 2025 ICU Medical Introduces Its New Category of Infusion Devices With FDA Clearances of Plum Solo ™ and Plum Duo ™ Precision IV Pumps New devices address infusion delivery variability and expand ICU Medical IV Performance Platform

News / Apr 01, 2025 ICU Medical’s Infusion Assessment Program Earns INS Seal of Approval INS Seal of Approval recognizes ICU Medical’s Infusion Assessment Program as a trusted resource for helping hospitals improve infusion therapy safety and align with evidence-based best practices.

pages.raw_meta: A robust portfolio of intravenous solution options in flexible containers, including fluid and electrolyte replenishment, IV medication patient administration, and tamper- evident accessories.
raw_blocks: IV supply should never be a question.
Another patient, another infusion, another moment where you rely on supplies to simply be there. With no delays and no uncertainty. That’s why we approach IV solutions differently.

An over $500M expansion of IV solutions manufacturing in the US is enabling a new 500,000-square-foot facility and significant upgrades to the existing operations in Austin, TX. All to strengthen US-based manufacturing, expand capacity and advance DEHP-free innovation.
IV Solutions are manufactured by Otsuka ICU Medical LLC and distributed by ICU Medical Sales, Inc. unless otherwise noted.

We've partnered with Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, Inc. to create one of the largest IV solutions networks on the planet. They bring decades of non-PVC, non-DEHP IV solutions manufacturing expertise to complement our deep infusion therapy relationships.

The Otsuka ICU Medical LLC plant in Austin, TX is significantly expanding. Through this partnership, we're also actively seeking FDA-approval of offshore sites to create a truly global network. That's proactive, not reactive resilience.

Supply disruptions don’t wait. Neither do we. We offer dedicated warehousing space to hold guaranteed safety stock for contracted customers in times of need. We ship in 1-2 days and are licensed to ship to all 50 states, so you have what you need when you need it.
Every solution, ready when you are.
And we do all we can to make sure it stays that way.
Flexible container options for reliable, everyday use.
A range to support every need.
Ready to meet compliance standards.
All you need to support IV nutrition.

pages.raw_meta: Your trusted partner in delivering innovative healthcare solutions and improving patient care.
raw_blocks: We believe the heart of healthcare is human connection.
Human connection is what turns procedures into care, clinicians into healers, and treatments into trust.
But in a world of growing complexity, it’s easy for that connection to get lost.

That’s why we design technology to support human moments, not compete with them. Tools that stay quietly in the background so clinicians can step forward. So instead of troubleshooting or juggling workarounds, they can focus fully on the person in front of them.
Because when tools safely do their job—with precision, clarity, and trust—people are free to do theirs: protect patients, solve problems, and lead with care.
We see what care demands because we listen closely to those who deliver it.

Every solution we build is shaped by deep collaboration with clinicians, pharmacists, and administrators—working together to solve real-world challenges, help eliminate preventable harm, and simplify complexity at every level.
That collaboration fuels a system of tools that are thoughtfully connected—integrating data, workflows, and insight—to help teams move faster, stay aligned, and deliver better care.
And because healthcare doesn’t wait, we don’t either. We act with urgency and flexibility, supporting clinicians with reliable and responsive partnership where and when it matters most.
Because when clinicians are supported—when tools are seamless, safe, and built around their realities—human connection thrives.
Support a healthcare experience free from preventable harm.
Because behind every safety breakthrough is a human life made safer—and a connection made stronger.
Empower clinicians to drive measurable improvements in every patient’s care.
When clinicians are supported with clarity, precision, and trust, human connection thrives—and so does care.
Move with urgency to collaboratively develop and reliably deliver meaningful innovation that simplifies complexity, enhances precision, and helps improve safety.
We listen closely, act quickly, and never lose sight of the people at the center of every decision, every design, and every delivery.
This is just the beginning.

As healthcare evolves, we’re evolving with it—working shoulder to shoulder with clinicians helping to build a healthcare experience where fewer things go wrong, more things go right, and human connection thrives.
